title: Extend a fixed diagram to non-torsion coefficient fields
statement: Let ell be prime and Y,P1_Y,P1_Y×_Y P1_Y Noetherian, with ell a unit on Y. For every Diagram d of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category] over condensed Z_ell with the fixed line zlLine, there exists a Family of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams] whose Z_ell component is literally d. All integral, rational, closure and transition scalar squares are the specified adjoint-normalized ScalarCompatibility data. No completed reference or finite quotient realization is asserted.

source.place: paragraphs (1)--(2), finite-free extension, localization and finite-field colimit

proof.text: For each finite subextension E, apply the finite coefficient extension theorem to the fixed input d. Choose its integral and rational diagrams and their two ScalarCompatibility records, obtaining the complete finite-stage data with the same input Z_ell component.

Apply the finite closure theorem to these fixed diagrams and the two compatibility families. Obtain the common closure diagram, all rational-to-closure compatibility records and every rational transition record.
Assemble Family with zl literally d, the chosen finite diagrams and closure, and the four families of ScalarCompatibility witnesses. Its zl projection equals d by reflexivity.

proof_origin.place: paragraphs (1)--(2), assemble single-finite-field extension and coherent finite-field closure
